name: Yunnan Energy Investment Co., Ltd.
summary: Yunnan Energy Investment Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various salt products in China. It offers natural salt, low sodium calcium, low sodium, uniodized and iodized raw rock salt, blackened crystal, ground black calcium, ground black low sodium, non-iodized low sodium, seaweed salt, salt for curing meat, and lavender foot bath salts, as well as fruits and vegetables pickling salt. In addition, the company provides coconut milk foot bath, heating ginger foot bath, rose foot bath, revitalizing peppermint foot bath, and health-preserving sandalwood foot bath salts.
